I'm scanning through the CA coordinates residue by residue, checking spacing patterns to spot helical or strand-like structure across this 58-residue chain.

Still generating coordinate list...

Now I'm checking consecutive CA-CA distances to validate the chain, then computing i,i+3 spacings to see whether the fold looks more like an extended strand or a helix -- the distances I'm getting (around 9-10 Å) point toward an extended conformation rather than a helix.

Still computing segment distances...

Continuing through the remaining segment distances and directions, I'm tracking the point-to-point displacement vectors and their magnitudes as the path winds through negative and positive coordinate ranges, noting one turn point around segment 42-45.

Most of the distances cluster around 9-10 Å for i,i+3 spacing, which points to extended beta strand conformation rather than helix. Given how few helical segments appear, I'll conclude the structure is predominantly beta sheet.
